build_MinCovDet_robust_covariance: build a robust covariance estimator using MinCovDet resistant to outliers in Gaussian data
build_EmpiricalCovariance_MLE: build a maximum likelihood covariance estimator using EmpiricalCovariance on Gaussian data
test_Mahalanobis_distances_MCD: test Mahalanobis distances computed by MinCovDet to distinguish inliers from outliers
test_Mahalanobis_distances_MLE: test Mahalanobis distances computed by EmpiricalCovariance affected by outlier contamination
compare_robust_vs_empirical_covariance: compare robust MCD and non-robust MLE covariance estimators on contaminated Gaussian data
